units.source_text: 某个秋日雨后的傍晚，他路过郊外的陆桥下面。

en.t: One evening after rain on an autumn day, he passed beneath an overpass in the outskirts.

units.source_text: 他看见一辆货运马车正停在陆桥对面的堤坝下。

en.t: He saw a freight cart standing below the embankment on the far side of the overpass.

units.source_text: 他经过那里的时候，他感到有人曾经走过这条路。

en.t: As he passed through that place, he felt that someone had once taken this road before.
Who could it have been? There was no need to ask him.

units.source_text: 二十三岁的他的心里，浮现出一个被割去了耳朵的荷兰人，

en.t: In the mind of his twenty-three-year-old self there appeared a Dutchman whose ear had been cut off,

units.source_text: 荷兰人嘴里叼着长烟斗，锐利的目光凝视着这幅忧郁的风景画……

en.t: the Dutchman holding a long pipe in his mouth, his sharp gaze fixed on this melancholy landscape painting...
